The Zoonova AI Quad-Ensemble machine learning architecture—comprising high-frequency time-series regressors, binary classification arrays for directional alpha probability, NLP transformer sentiment feeds, and macro-breadth regime models—indicates a resilient consolidation pattern across major large-cap benchmarks. Regression residuals for the S&P 500 ETF (SPY) remain tightly bound within a $\pm 0.85\sigma$ channel, while the NASDAQ 100 ETF (QQQ) exhibits elevated high-frequency variance driven by semiconductor rotation.
